name: Metamagic Rod, Crypt
body:
Price varies; Slot none; CL 17th; Weight 5 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

Lesser crypt metamagic rod 3,000 gp; Crypt metamagic rod 11,000 gp; Greater crypt metamagic rod 24,500 gp; Aura strong (no school)

The wielder of this metamagic rod can cast up to three spells per day that condemn the targets as though using the Crypt Spell feat.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost varies: Lesser crypt metamagic rod 1,500 gp; Crypt metamagic rod 5,500 gp; Greater crypt metamagic rod 12,250 gp; Feats Craft Rod, Crypt Spell*
